name: live-v15-host-restore
objective: v2.3 replan V15, live on a real group (no model): a checkpoint in chat A disables Luke on the group; LEAVING for chat B, which ALREADY plays another story (so-v15-other, which touches no cast: sun-ruins disables Luke itself at cp1 once story-scoped lore, f7342021, makes it ready), puts Luke back (before V15 only a storyless destination restored anything — the first draft of this check left for a fresh chat, took the storyless path, and passed with the fix removed, so the destination here is prepared first); RETURNING to A re-applies its cast from the mirror; RESTART puts Luke back again. Every step reads the group's own disabled_members.

requires.why: road disables Luke on the toy group and every leave/return/restart reads that group's disabled_members; the runner re-enables a Luke an earlier run left disabled

steps.eval: const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); if (String(ctx.groupId) !== (SillyTavern.getContext().groups.find((g) => g.name === 'Group: Arin, DM Narrator')?.id)) throw new Error(`run this in group 'Group: Arin, DM Narrator', not ${ctx.groupId}`); const group = ctx.groups.find((entry) => String(entry.id) === (SillyTavern.getContext().groups.find((g) => g.name === 'Group: Arin, DM Narrator')?.id)); const luke = group.members.find((member) => /^luke/i.test(member)); if (!luke) throw new Error(`no Luke in ${JSON.stringify(group.members)}`); if ((group.disabled_members ?? []).includes(luke)) throw new Error('Luke is already disabled: the baseline must have him enabled'); globalThis.__v15 = { chatB: String(ctx.chatId), luke, baseline: [...(group.disabled_members ?? [])] }; return globalThis.__v15;

globalThis.__v15.chatA = String(SillyTavern.getContext().chatId); if (globalThis.__v15.chatA === globalThis.__v15.chatB) throw new Error('/newchat did not open a second chat'); return { chatA: globalThis.__v15.chatA };

steps.send: We leave the tavern for the road.

steps.eval: const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const group = ctx.groups.find((entry) => String(entry.id) === (SillyTavern.getContext().groups.find((g) => g.name === 'Group: Arin, DM Narrator')?.id)); if (!group.disabled_members.includes(globalThis.__v15.luke)) throw new Error('road did not disable Luke'); const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const row = rt.getSnapshot().effects.ledger.filter((entry) => entry.effect === 'cast').at(-1); if (row?.target?.group !== (SillyTavern.getContext().groups.find((g) => g.name === 'Group: Arin, DM Narrator')?.id)) throw new Error(`the ledger did not record the group: ${JSON.stringify(row)}`); return { disabled: group.disabled_members, row: { status: row.status, group: row.target.group } };

const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); await ctx.openGroupChat((SillyTavern.getContext().groups.find((g) => g.name === 'Group: Arin, DM Narrator')?.id), globalThis.__v15.chatB); for (let i = 0; i < 40 && (String(SillyTavern.getContext().chatId) !== globalThis.__v15.chatB || globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.getSnapshot().storyId !== 'so-v15-other'); i += 1) await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 250)); await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 1500)); const now = SillyTavern.getContext(); if (String(now.chatId) !== globalThis.__v15.chatB) throw new Error(`could not open chat B: ${now.chatId}`); const story = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.getSnapshot().storyId; if (story !== 'so-v15-other') throw new Error(`chat B is not playing its own story (${story}): the leave would take the storyless path this check exists to avoid`); const group = now.groups.find((entry) => String(entry.id) === (SillyTavern.getContext().groups.find((g) => g.name === 'Group: Arin, DM Narrator')?.id)); if (group.disabled_members.includes(globalThis.__v15.luke)) throw new Error('leaving for a chat that plays ANOTHER story left Luke disabled on the shared group'); return { chatB: now.chatId, story, disabled: group.disabled_members };

const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); await ctx.openGroupChat((SillyTavern.getContext().groups.find((g) => g.name === 'Group: Arin, DM Narrator')?.id), globalThis.__v15.chatA); for (let i = 0; i < 40 && (String(SillyTavern.getContext().chatId) !== globalThis.__v15.chatA || globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.getSnapshot().storyId !== 'so-v15-cast'); i += 1) await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 250)); await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 1500)); const now = SillyTavern.getContext(); if (String(now.chatId) !== globalThis.__v15.chatA) throw new Error(`could not return to chat A: ${now.chatId}`); const group = now.groups.find((entry) => String(entry.id) === (SillyTavern.getContext().groups.find((g) => g.name === 'Group: Arin, DM Narrator')?.id)); const state = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.getEngineState(); if (state.activeCheckpointId !== 'road') throw new Error(`chat A came back on ${state.activeCheckpointId}`); if (!group.disabled_members.includes(globalThis.__v15.luke)) throw new Error('returning to chat A did not re-apply its cast: Luke is enabled while its checkpoint says he stays behind'); return { back: now.chatId, active: state.activeCheckpointId, disabled: group.disabled_members };

const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const ok = await rt.restartStory(true); await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 1000)); const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const group = ctx.groups.find((entry) => String(entry.id) === (SillyTavern.getContext().groups.find((g) => g.name === 'Group: Arin, DM Narrator')?.id)); if (!ok) throw new Error('restart did not run'); if (rt.getEngineState().activeCheckpointId !== 'start') throw new Error(`restart landed on ${rt.getEngineState().activeCheckpointId}`); if (group.disabled_members.includes(globalThis.__v15.luke)) throw new Error('restart left Luke disabled on the group'); const baseline = JSON.stringify([...globalThis.__v15.baseline].sort()); const now = JSON.stringify([...group.disabled_members].sort()); if (baseline !== now) throw new Error(`the group does not match its baseline: ${now} vs ${baseline}`); return { restarted: true, disabled: group.disabled_members };

const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const id = (SillyTavern.getContext().groups.find((g) => g.name === 'Group: Arin, DM Narrator')?.id); const group = (ctx.groups ?? []).find((entry) => String(entry.id) === id); if (!group) return { skipped: 'the toy group is not loaded' }; const luke = (group.members ?? []).find((member) => /^luke/i.test(member)); const now = [...(group.disabled_members ?? [])]; const baseline = Array.isArray(globalThis.__v15?.baseline) ? [...globalThis.__v15.baseline] : now.filter((member) => member !== luke); const next = baseline.filter((member) => member !== luke); const sorted = (list) => JSON.stringify([...list].sort()); let wrote = false; if (sorted(now) !== sorted(next)) { const response = await fetch('/api/groups/edit', { method: 'POST', headers: ctx.getRequestHeaders(), body: JSON.stringify({ ...group, disabled_members: next }) }); if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`could not put the toy group back: HTTP ${response.status}`); group.disabled_members = next; wrote = true; } const all = await (await fetch('/api/groups/all', { method: 'POST', headers: ctx.getRequestHeaders(), body: '{}', cache: 'no-cache' })).json(); const stored = (Array.isArray(all) ? all : []).find((entry) => String(entry.id) === id); if (luke && (stored?.disabled_members ?? []).includes(luke)) throw new Error(`Luke is still disabled on the server copy of the toy group: ${JSON.stringify(stored?.disabled_members)}`); delete globalThis.__v15; return { wrote, before: now, after: stored?.disabled_members ?? null };
